content: Wuxi University in Jiangsu, China offers 100% Full Tuition Scholarships for international Bachelor's degree students in Software Engineering, Computer Science, and International Trade. Annual accommodation fee is only around $300-$500/year, and living costs in Wuxi are approx $250/month.

To apply for a National D-Type Study Visa for Poland (Schengen Zone), Uzbek students need an Official Acceptance Letter from a Polish university (e.g. Warsaw University of Technology or Vistula University), apostilled High School Diploma, bank statement showing min. €3,500-€4,000 for living expenses, and health insurance covering €30,000.

IU International University of Applied Sciences in Germany offers English-taught Bachelor's and Master's programs in Data Science, AI, and Business. Students can choose online or on-campus study in Berlin/Bad Honnef and get 18-month post-study work visa in Germany.

Most partner universities in China and Poland accept Duolingo English Test (minimum 95-105) or IELTS (minimum 5.5 - 6.0). Some universities in China allow admission with an official English Proficiency Letter from your high school if you studied in English.

Uni World application steps: 1. Register on Uni World Student Portal and request OTP verification. 2. Fill profile details and upload Passport + Diploma + IELTS scan. 3. Receive 1-on-1 counselor review & university submission. 4. Receive official University Acceptance Letter within 2-4 weeks.
